meta.name: Greece
meta.blurb: Three mountain borders and four seas. Restore the empire of Basil II, from the Danube to Antioch.
meta.pitch: a 1936 grand-strategy war map of Greece
meta.capitalFalls: The government leaves Athens for Crete. The war goes on from Chania.
meta.capitalFreed: Athens is free again. The flag flies over the Acropolis.

landmarks.desc: Enter Constantinople, the Queen of Cities
Reach Antioch, the seat of the doux of the East

medalNames.hundreddays: Order of Saints George and Constantine

days.text: Kali Chronia. Saint Basil’s day: cut the vasilopita and find the coin.
Chronia polla. The twenty-fifth of March: the banner of 1821 is raised again on every front.
On this day in 1453 the City fell. The lamps of Hagia Sophia are waiting.
Dekapentavgoustos. The bells ring on every island of the Archipelago.

meta.motto: Πάλι με χρόνους, με καιρούς, πάλι δικά μας θα ’ναι — “Again, with the years, with time, they will be ours once more.”
